newsitem.title: USA: Fleet to redeploy 800 branch jobs.
newsitem.headline: Fleet to redeploy 800 branch jobs.

text.p: Fleet Financial Group Inc said it will redeploy 800 positions, mostly tellers, from its 1,200 bank branches over the next seven weeks to more centralized operations.

"We're redeploying positions from the branch operations into areas such as telephone banking, investment services, insurance sales and discount brokerage," said James Mahoney, a spokesman. "We've basically refined our business plan based on customer use patters and customer preference for products."
Mahoney said an undetermined number of people may lose their jobs with the redeployment.
"We're hoping to redeploy as many of the people as we can. However, we do expect there will be some number of people who will require severance packages," he said.
He said the bank hopes to maintain its current employment of about 35,000 people.
